notes.title: Announcement - Game closes, on the 1st of April
notes.content:
Dear Warmonger Community!

We are very sad to make the following announcement. At the end of March 2019, Warmonger will be closed and all servers will be taken offline on the first of April. All payment options are taken offline with this announcement.

Since the beginning of the development of Warmonger we had our ups and downs with the project but we were always able to overcome these struggles due to your great support. Unfortunately we now reached the point that even with great support and effort we are no longer able to keep the game running.

That said we would like to thank everyone who believed in the developers, their game and who was part of its development. Without you we wouldn't even have been able to do it and for that again we are over all means thankful and hope you had a lot of fun in Gaia!

Your Warmonger Team

PS: Until the final curtain falls we will set these events live: 100% Drop and 
2x Medals.

notes.title: [Patchlog] 24.01.19
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

[u][h1]Patchlog[/h1][/u]
Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we’ll see you in Gaia.

[u][h1]Items[/h1][/u]
After some of the latest changes the usability of potions was less and less relevant. With the following Patch we double the effectiveness of the following Elixirs and Flasks.[list]
[*][i] Elixir of Health [C][/i] ; Health Reg. 1 -> 2
[*][i] Elixir of Health [noparse][B][/noparse][/i] ; Health Reg. 2 -> 4
[*][i] Elixir of Health [A][/i] ; Health Reg. 3 -> 6
[*][i] Elixir of Health [S][/i] ; Health Reg. 4 -> 8
[*][i] Flask of Mana [C][/i] ; Mana Reg. 1 -> 2
[*][i] Flask of Mana [noparse][B][/noparse][/i] ; Mana Reg. 2 -> 4
[*][i] Flask of Mana [A][/i] ; Mana Reg. 3 -> 6
[*][i] Flask of Mana [S][/i] ; Mana Reg. 4 -> 8
[/list]

[b]Magical Demolition Hammer[/b]
Due to some controversy regarding the damage of the Q-ability of the Magical Demolition Hammer, this caused on some builds the view that this skill made less damage than a normal basic attack. We adjusted the tooltip of the Skill to clarify the skill better. The applied damage is [b]magic damage[/b] which uses the magic penetration value for the resulting damage calculation.
We also adjusted the bonus damage rates to focus more on the AP ratio to incentivize a more AP focused build for Guardians on this weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/a459542c2fc12bfcace40e2d450857e6f3a8175f.png[/img] [b]Q – Ability: [i]Soul Infestation[/i][/b][list]
[*] Bonus AD multiplier: 100% -> 75%
[*] Bonus AP multiplier: 30% -> 60%
[*] Your basic attacks deals 10 (+60%AP)(+75%AD) [b]Magic Damage[/b]. You know hit multiple opponents at once.[/list]

[u][h1] Systems[/h1][/u]
[b]Mysterious World[/b]
We checked the performance on Mysterious World and noticed a large amount of feedback regarding missing Gold and issues regarding T8 Materials. Due to this we changed the Focus of the EXP dungeon (Sinking Nest) to focus now on Crystals and GemStones.
Additionally to control in some way the material output of these areas we limit the time duration. And fixed the general drop output since it was set to high.[list]
[*] Time limit: Unlimited -> 3 hours[/list]

[u][h1]Quests[/h1][/u]
Due to the high material provision of the Mysterious World the need of Free Quests is less given. We removed them therefore again from the QuestBoard. They can still be obtained from the NPCs over the course of the game.

[b][Daily] Kill Player[/b]
Since the EXP version of the Mysterious world is now shifted towards gemstones and crystals the rewards and requirements of this quest were slightly adjusted.[list]
[*] Added a small EXP and Gold Reward
[*] Bot kills count towards completion of the quest.[/list]

[u][h1]Bug[/h1][/u][list]
[*]We fixed a bug which prevented the correct integration of the [i]Skeleton king’s Vision Bow[/i] in the gacha system.

[*]We fixed a bug regarding toggle skills such as [i] (Magical Blade Shield or WaterColumn)[/i]. It is now no longer possible that skills which consume a certain amount of Mana per second stop consuming mana if the mana bar gets filled to 100% during the skill being active.

[*] An issue which allowed ranged weapons with a range of 750 to hit the Nexus without being target by the nexus itself was resolved. We slightly increased the range of the Nexus to be always above the 750 range of weapons.

[*] A display issue on the TR localization was fixed where on the character status screen “Armor Penetration” was falsely displayed as “Magic Resistance”.
[/list]

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]
Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we’ll see you in Gaia.

[u][h1]Items[/h1][/u]
[b] Innocence Crystals [/b]
To offer low level players also a way to experience the power of hero transformations we adjusted the Innocence Crystals. Note that complete Innocence’s are still restricted to level 30.[List]
[*] Delete Level restriction for Innocence: Crystals
[*] Changed Durability to 1500

[*] Adjusted the cost for creating an Innocence Crystal to 5 Innocence Pieces plus a corresponding number of red fragments. [/list]

[b]Blessing of Shaia[/b][list]
We adjusted slightly the effectiveness of the item
[*] Points granted per item use increased (premium item): 1000 -> 2000
[*] Points granted when in town or unconnected decreased form: 2000 -> 1000
[*] Points consume when a Monster gets killed: 5 -> 10[/list]

[b]Runes[/b]
With this patch runes will also be effected by the PvP stat correction. If a Players has no runes there won’t be a correction for his runes.

[b] Guild Core [/b]
We added two cores which enable each a TP skill that can be used in PvP or PvE matches of the land where the core is invested.[list]
[*] [b][i]Powerful remote Bomb[/i][/b]
PvP: Attacks the Nexus after destroying all enemies attacking towers.
PvE: Attacks all bosses after attacking the middle boss.
[*] [b][i]Powerful Nexus Remote Bomb[/i][/b] 
Attacks the Nexus. (Stronger version of the normal TP Skill)
[/list]

[u][h1] Systems[/h1][/u]
[b] Daily Quest[/b]
[i] - Monster Area Wars (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)[/i]
We adjusted the requirement. Now also War of Warmonger counts towards this Quest.

[i]- Boss Hunt (Monthly)[/i]
Adjusted the requirement to fullfil the quest from 100 – 50.

[b] War of Warmonger[/b]
We adjusted the schedule of the event to be more frequently.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/94fe7626dcfa028c868d0ead0518ef906ae10908.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/338aca6fe7957fd47221bd46ba0b3093c46084e3.png[/img][/url]

Additionally we changes some other mechanics for the event.[list]
[*] In each match of [i]“War of Warmonger”[/i] for both teams there will be up to 15 Bots to max out both teams.
[*] Increased the HP of the Nexus to 70560 HP
[*] The PvP correction Bonus for Runes apply in “War of Warmonger” matches also.[/list]

[b] Holy Thing[/b]
We adjusted the state of the Holy Thing Event to only occur in one area instead of multiples. Also, we tried to tackle the issue of multiple cores which are obtained from Holy Thing Events. Therefore, if multiples of the same are obtained the tier of the Holy Thing Items increases.

[b]Nation Support Fund[/b]
We adjusted the fund which provides a Nation Support to users. Now players need to battle in Gaia Field to have access to the fund.
At the same time players who for example participate in a Siege War can gain additional Funds.

notes.title: [Patchlog] 20.09
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]

Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we’ll see you in Gaia.

[h1]Items[/h1]
[b] Boss Sets [/b]
A new Boss set where added called [i]Leviathan Set[/i]. This Set should especially interesting for Saints and AP builds.

[b]Superior Weapon Crafting[/b]
All weapons have now a small chance of also becoming superior weapons while being created.
All superior weapons are now also possible to drop from the Weapon Gacha.

[b]Item Reinforcement[/b]
To provide our players base a new progression and motivation to rule the battlefield we are happy to announce that we increased the maximal reinforcement to [b][i] Tier4 +15[/i][/b].
To create a T4 Gear or weapon not only [b][i]Orange Passion[/i][/b] are needed but this time also [b][i]Brilliant Passions[/i][/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/a7904ba82ca1aae7706ebdb5cdef9d163b7c2c52.png[/img]

To provide more PvP motivation we adjusted the medal prices for some of these newly needed materials as followed: [list]
[*]Brilliant Passion -> Silver 5 , Gold 1
[*]Amplifying Passion -> Silver 5 , Gold 3[/List]

[b]Runes[/b]
As we adjusted the need for Fame Materials for reinforcement. We also revisited the creating of runes and their reinforcing. In this step we adjusted and increased the overall possibility of successfully reinforcing a rune to the next level.
The matrial costs were in also adjusted to feature now less [i] Crystals[/i] but similar to the T4 reinforcement now also Fame Items.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/fd91f5317c36e05cb421fa44c56a3ab1d8e0263d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/f564d420482aff28482780ba3372e23b790ade36.png[/img][/url]

[b]PvP Gear Bonus adjustment[/b]
We revisited and adjusted some of the PvP Gear Sets. Adjustments included Stats and Set Bonus.

[b] Costume Medal price change [/b]
Medal price for Costumes has been changed: [list]
[*]Gold 50 -> Gold 10
[*]Silver 50 -> Silver 25[/list]

[b]Lord of the Land[/b]
We lowered the Gold price to open a reward box from the Lord of the Land Buff.[list]
[*]300.000 Gold -> 200.000 Gold[/List]
We will keep an eye on this and might adjust things further if we feel that this is still not the reprehensive amount for this reward.

[h1] Systems[/h1]
[b] Fortress and Shields[/b]
We reviewed for some time the motivation for Fortress sieges. We think that they are the most iconic and enjoyable feature in the game. As we tried to focus more on this feature and make it more enjoyable we also discovered that with the protective manners we implemented an active Fortress Siege wasn’t quite possible any longer. To ensure again a fast-paced experience in regards of Fortress Sieges we remove the Invincibility of Fortresses if a Nation has more than one left. 

This shall open up also the design space which we are currently investing to provide a system on a similar but also smaller scale.
As we also well-know about the risk of nations losing a lot of possibility to compete with the other nation after their Fort with the most Mastery points are destroyed we prepared a chase where all items are available even without the Masteries this system will also revisited shortly after this patch to develop an alternative which doesn’t let Nations be defenseless.[list]
[*] All Items can be made in the fort – Transient event [/list]

[b] Reduced medal acquisition for bot [/b]
We reduced the number of medal points earned on kills and assists from Bots. This shall help in to avoid getting large amounts of medals and fame without the need to actively enter in PvP combat.

[b]Jungle monsters[/b]
We adjusted the logic behind the PvP Jungle Monsters do provide them a better function and value within a Battle.

[h1]PvE Changes[/h1]
[b] Monster Drop Change [/b]
The drop chances of Monsters on the Gaia Fields and in Dungeon have been adjusted.

On the same behave we increased the drop chances for Boss materials form the Fortress Guardians and Dungeon Bosses, so players can obtain the required essences and rare materials for their Sets faster.

[b] New Dungeon [/b]
We added a new Dungeon called [i]Dragon Island[/i]. This dungeon will only be accessible through the dimension gate on a field and not via the Dimension Gate within a Fortress.

[b] Abyss [/b]
The abilities of the Tow Chiefs and the Ancient Ghost have been increased to provide a more exciting experience.

[h1] UI [/h1]
[b]Fame[/b]
In preparation of a game system in regards of fame and the increased requirement of fame for items we adjusted the UI and naming of the [i]Cumulative Fame [/i] to [i]Contribution[/i].

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]

Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we see you in Gaia.

[h1]Items[/h1]
[b] Crafting with yellow Jewels[/b]
It is now possible to craft “normal” Gear and “1Tier” runes with yellow jewels should a player have insufficient materials for the actual crafting. The jewel cost is calculated based on the amount of Materials needed. Players have therefore the decision to farm the needed materials or take a shortcut and directly create the item with Jewels only.

[b] Crafting via Castle[/b]
To lower the devastating results for a nation after loosing its Masteries it is now possible to craft gear weapons and elixirs in the nation castle. For this we provided the necessary NPCs in the Castle.

[h1]Systems[/h1]
[b]Fortress Cores[/b]
Cores for constructing of a Fortresses have an increased chance to drop from corresponding events If the number of Fortresses is low on the map for a nation.

[b]PvP bots[/b]
While participating in PvP bots will now be created based on the amount of time a Battlefield is taking.

[b]Stability[/b]
We further on strength the game stability to provide a smooth game experience.

As we try to stabilize the client performance we try out certain features and functions which sometimes don’t work the way we assumed. Because of that we remove the DWM Sync option again from the game as it resulted in the exact opposite of what our goal was.
Additionally, we implemented a third Framerate limiter (Type1). All three work slightly different from each other. We hope to increase with this the overall client issues.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]

Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we see you in Gaia.

[h1]Systems[/h1]
[b] FPS Limits and SYNC[/b]
To optimize the game experience and to lower the occurring reports of stuttering we reviewed the FPS limiter and SYNC options of in the game again. We have now two versions available for both Syncing and Limiter. 
The new limiter is now on a better calculation level which should help to decrease any occurring issues. As this new Limiter unfortunately might not work in that way with older systems such as Windows XP we kept the old limiters as well for players who use an older system.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/dd89f7e17fa780d8b6f8e6b4eacb393c3ecff381.png[/img]

To offer an alternative or extension to the SYNC options we also included now besides the VSync a DWM Sync. This one behaves like the VSync but should have in general a slightly better performance. Players have also the option to use both Sync Systems at the same time.

[b] Mail System [/b]
Due to the occasions of some exploits and issues with players who used Mulit-Account using to harm the game it isn’t possible anymore to send in-game mails between the two nations. In-game mails can now only be sent within the nation of the player.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A bug by which the Nexus would attack its own team after receiving a debuff from a friendly source were fixed.
[*] We fixed some strings which were misleading and displayed the wrong item description. Also renamed the item Mystery Potion to Blessing of Shaia. It can only be one Blessing active and it won’t stack.
[*] A bug by which some dungeons didn’t appear due to a wrongly calculation of the Main Fortress was fixed.
[*] A bug by which some UI messages were wrongly displayed in the item shop was fixed.
[*] A bug by which some players had difficulties to participate in Wars if they directly moved from a Fortress was fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes 26.07
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]

Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we see you in Gaia.

[h1] Gameplay [/h1]

[b]Fort Distance[/b]
We adjusted the calculation for mechanics in regards of the distant to the Forts. With this change the fortress with the highest level is considered the Main Fortress. All calculations which refer to a distant to a Fortress will now take this new declared Main Fortress as their basis.

[b]Entry Costs[/b]
As we changed the calculation for distant. We also adjusted the entry cost in for Dungeons: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/91bba0b3010a60c525da4c465b9ef463683e3ec1.png[/img]

As there are no longer Time Energy required as an entry Fee for Hardcore Dungeons, all three Time Energy Items got reviewed and reimplemented as buff items which provide additional Drop Chance for a short period of time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/fc897e5da690ab49d4cdfb324a1df21ad4747b13.png[/img]

[b]Fortress, inviolable zones[/b]
Due to the large timer where a Fortress wasn’t attackable nearly no Fortresses where attacked and multiple Fortresses could again be established. To open this up now again the inviolable zone are now take the number of fortresses into account.[List]
[*] 1 -> ------
[*] 2 -> 30 min
[*] 3 -> 15 min
[*] 4 -> 5 min[/list]

[b] Runes[/b]
Rune Reinforcements are now possible up to  +9 reinforcements.

[b]Superior Gear[/b]
We adjusted slightly the stats and added some new Gear pieces to the game.

[b]Monster invasion Timer[/b]
As monster invasions seemed to not play a big part of the game we adjusted the timer it takes for monsters to occupy a land again. We hope to make the overall game pace with this faster and more interesting. This shall also solve some issues with newer players which are in the need of some NPC lands for their Quests or Farming. These where the previous rules in this regard: 

[i]Existing Rules[/i] (These rules remain the same)[list]
[*] Safety rate decreases once every 30 minutes.
[*] The decreasing value is proportional to the distance.
[*] At a safety rate of 30 or less, a monster invasion occurs with an 80% chance.
[*] When the Safety rate is below 0, it is captured by the monster.
[*] Safety rate of field dungeon clear increases by 5.
[*] If you have nearby monster occupied fields, Safety rate is further reduced.
[/list]
[i]Rules which got added[/i][list]
[*] The additional reduction rule reduces the safety rate additionally.
[*] The additional reduction rule is not affected by distance.
[*] The amount of additional reduction is cumulative. (Safety rate decreases more rapidly with time.)
[*] The cumulative value decreases when the dungeon is cleared.
[*] The safety rate is less than 30 and the cumulative additional reduction can be taken immediately with a proportionate probability.
[*] No additional rules apply to the fields owned by the guild[/list]

[h1]Systems[/h1]

[b] Gear Creation[/b]
It is now possible when you craft Gear that you receive the Gear as a superior one instead. 

[b] Daily Gacha[/b]
We adjusted the loadout for the Daily Gacha and added some new items. Newly items which were added are:[List]
[*] [b]Yellow Jewels package [100 / 200 / 1000]
[*] 1-3 Tier Weapons
[*] 1-3 Tier Gear[/list]
Additional the payout got increased from previous 5 to 10 rewards.

[b] Daily Quest[/b]
UI field gets now automatically displayed if a player connects with a character above Lv27.
We increased also the reward of Jewels and Fame for completing Daily Quests.

[b]Return player Reward[/b]
We added an automatic reward and Quest package for players which returned to the game after a long time of being offline.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A bug by which the Tow Chief in the Abyss Stage weren’t respawning correctly sometimes were fixed.
[*] We fixed some strings which were misleading and displayed the wrong item description.
[/list]

notes.title: [Patchlog 28.06]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]

Here are the changes which were applied in the last maintenance, enjoy the read and we see you in Gaia.

[h1] Gameplay [/h1]

[b]Quest[/b]
The quests regarding equipping items and how to use Innocence were adjusted to make them more understandable.

[b]Hero[/b]
As heroes still seem to be a devastating force on every battlefield they are used on and are even viewed as unfair in a way, we adjusted their power in regard to their upgraded level. Therefore, the ratio of bonus stats a Hero receives from the player's gear has been changed. We will review the outcome of this change throughout the next weeks and might adjust them again if we see that the result isn’t as intended. Example:
[list]
[*] Hero (Hero T1 +0) -> 35% Stat Bonus from Gear
[*] Hero (Hero T1 +15) -> 45% Stat Bonus from Gear
[*] Hero (Hero T2 +10) -> 65% Stat Bonus from Gear
[*] Hero (Hero T3 +15) -> 100% Stat Bonus from Gear
[/list]

[b]Fortress Wars[/b]
We discovered that players find it difficult to impossible to defend a Fortress against an attacking team that is better equipped. Therefore we decided to add the gear bonus for the defending team to provide a better experience for all players. This bonus shouldn’t be seen as a nullifier of the attacking team's efforts. Additionally we have added an invincibility buff if players use internal portals to avoid the portal spawn killing:
[list]
[*]Gear Bonus added to Defending Team
[*]Invincibility when using internal Portals (3 sec.)
[/list]

[b] Double Event Field [/b]
A newly added event which is only visible to the weaker Nation to concentrate efforts of a Nation towards one explicit field.
[list]
[*] Event field spawns around the boarder of the Nation.
[*] If conquered, players of the weaker Nation receive double the amount of medal rewards.
[*] Double Event Field spawns every hour.
[*] It will only be one Double Event field active at a time.
[*] Should a field currently be under attack when the respawn time hits [ 0 ], the new spawn is delayed until the previous fight is completed.
[/list]
 [h1]Bug / Technical improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] A bug by which Deathhead's Quick Attack would deal zero damage has been fixed. 
[*] A bug in the reinforcement UI which was displayed faulty has been fixed.
[*] A bug where the HP bar border wasn’t correctly displayed based on rank of the players' Legion has been fixed.
[*] A bug during Fortress Sieges by which the Crusader kept its regeneration ability even if the Heart of Magic was destroyed has been fixed.
[*] The criteria for event fields to spawn on the map have been adjusted.
[*] The server environment has been improved to provide a more stable connection and to reduce the lag some players experienced.
[*] For better visibility in the chat we also removed the fame rank of a player if they are using the command chat.
[/list]

notes.title: Warmonger Creator Program
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/bf340d2548a3005513d513fd2d45632c9ea3bbe3.png[/img]

We want you! If you’re excited for the live release of Warmonger on the 14th of June and want to help us increase its popularity and improve the game, why not do so by creating some awesome content for it? Whether fan arts, streams, videos or other formats, every contribution helps to make Warmonger the game we all want it to be. If you would like to help us out, grab a chair and have a look at the details:

[h1]Why & What[/h1]
We would like to focus on the best part of every game - its community – and provide a way in which we can all benefit from it. You could create great guides, give feedback on certain mechanics, make action-driven montages or find a different way to reach out to people with the same interest as you. We want to make all of this possible with the [b]Warmonger Creator Program.[/b]

[h1]Benefits[/h1]
As part of the Warmonger Creator Program, our creators will not only receive the thankfulness of our community but also be part of the trusted and extended feedback group involved directly in the further development of the game. Additional benefits include:
[list]
[*]Exclusive access to our test server. Be one of [b]the first players to test[/b] and provide feedback on new mechanics and features.
[*]Access to a special channel on our [b]Discord Server[/b] for more precise and direct communication with the team and your fellow content creators.
[*][b]Content promotion[/b] via our official sites such as Facebook, Steam or Discord.
[*]A free amount of giveaway keys which offer [b]an Item Package worth 5-20€[/b] each.
[/list]

[h1]Qualification[/h1]
You won’t need much to be part of the Warmonger Creator Program. However, some points are still necessary to ensure a great experience for all members and safe handling.
[list]
[*]Own a distribution channel with preferably more than 100 Twitch Followers or 500 YouTube Subscribers. If your channel doesn’t have this number of followers, don’t worry, this is only one of many factors which will decide if a creator will be part of the program.
[*]Reliability: Every creator should be able to establish a schedule which offers one content distribution per week on a platform of their choice.
[*]Creators should be able to speak English well enough to ensure a good basis of communication. The content itself doesn’t need to be in English but it is recommended.
[*]Creators should already have some experience regarding content creation. If you are new to this and still want to be part of the Creator Program you can still apply for the program and try to convince us that you are the best creator out there!
[/list]

[h1]How to apply[/h1]
To offer a smooth processing of your applications, please follow the steps below.
[list]
[*]Send us your application in English via mail, stating why you want to be part of the Warmonger Creator Program: [b]wcp@gamesinflames.com[/b]
[*]State which distribution channel you want to use.
[*]To confirm that you’re indeed the owner of your stated channel please send us a corresponding note:
[olist]
[*][b]Twitch:[/b] Send us a direct message with your account with #WCP and your mail address https://www.twitch.tv/warmonger_game
[*][b]	Youtube:[/b] Send us the link of an unlisted video from your Youtube channel within your application.
[*][b]Others:[/b] Please provide valid proof that you are indeed the owner of these channels. If a confirmation can’t be made, we can’t accept the channel.
[/olist][/list]
Once your application has been sent, we will check the details. The lucky ones who are selected will be notified via the mail from which we received your application. Please note that this might take some time. Please note that we will only respond if you are chosen as potential creators.

[h1]Violation of the partnership[/h1]
Any act of fraud regarding the ownership of a channel or similar will be pursued and punished. Creators can be driven out of the Creator Program if they violate the Rules of Conduct:
[list]
[*]Reveal confidential information of any kind
[*]Display inappropriate content or behavior
[*]No use of proper logos, credits, or copyright information
[/list]
That being said, we hope that you are as excited as we are for this endeavor. You can sign up to the Warmonger Creator Program at any time and we are looking forward to reading your marvelous applications. Best wishes and see you soon on the fields of Gaia!

Your Warmonger Team

notes.title: [Patchlog] 12.04
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

[h1]Patchlog[/h1]

Here are the changes which where applied in the last maintenance. 

[h1]Upgradesystem[/h1]
We changed the penalty for failing a upgrade. The Item which shall be upgraded will now nolonger be destroyed if the upgrading fails. Required materials however are still consumed.
[list]
[*] Before: Item gets destroyed
[*] After: Item gets decreased by one Level. 
(+3 -> +2)
[/list]

[i]Note: Using "Reinforcing Adjuvants" prevents this penalty.[/i]


[h1]Item Changes[/h1]

[b]1. Weapons [/b]

[i]- Magical Protect Mace[/i]
Applys now Q- and R-Skill according to the party size

[i]- Magical Life Wand[/i]
[b]R-Skill[/b] We reduced the range and recovery amount 
[list]
[*] Range [ 8 -> 6 ]
[*] Recovery [ 6 -> 5 ]
[/list]
[i]- Tempest's Magical Wand[/i]
Improved visual feedback of [b]W-[/b] and [b]R-Skill[/b]

[i]-Magical Storm Wand[/i]
[b]E-Skill[/b] Increased AP multiplyer [20 -> 40]

[i]-Magical Crystal Wand[/i]
[b]W-Skill[/b] Increased bonus Attack and Movement Speed [13% -> 15%]
[b]E-Skill[/b] Increased Armor and Magic Resistance Buff and Debuff amount [10% -> 20%]
[b]R-Skill[/b] Increased Movement Speed Debuff [2 sec. -> 4 sec.]

[i]- Magical Dash Blade[/i]
We exchanged the stat increase per level for AP and AD
[list]
[*] AP per level [ 2 -> 8 ]
[*] AD per level [ 8 -> 2 ]
[/list]
[i]- Magical Wrath Blade[/i]
We exchanged the stat increase per level for AP and AD
[list]
[*] AP per level [ 2 -> 8 ]
[*] AD per level [ 8 -> 2 ]
[/list]
[i]-Magical Thunder Wand[/i]
[b]Q-Skill[/b] Increased AP base mulitplyer [70 -> 80]
[b]W-Skill[/b] Increased AP base mulitplyer [90 -> 100]
[b]E-Skill[/b] Reduced Cooldown [70 sec. -> 60 sec.]

[b]2. Runes[/b]
We adjusted the calculation of the stats per level to fit the new max level of some of the runes. [i]Note: Max level refers to a rune level +9[/i]
[list]
[*] Increased max value for Armor rune [ max. 45 ]
[*] Increased max value for Mana Rege.  rune [ max. 102 ]
[*] Increased max value for Magic Resist. rune [ max. 45 ]
[*] Increased max value for AP rune [ max. 60 ]
[*] Increased max value for AD rune [ max. 45 ]
[*] Adjusted level increase for Armor Pene. rune 
 Lv.7:  [13 -> 12]
 Lv.8:  [16 -> 14]
 Lv.9:  [19 -> 16]
[*] Adjusted level increase for Magic Resist. Pene. rune 
 Lv.7:  [13 -> 12]
 Lv.8:  [16 -> 13]
 Lv.9:  [19 -> 15]
[/list]

[b]3. Hero[/b]
We adjusted the passive traits while being transformed into a hero.

[i]- Artamos[/i]
Decreased Critical chance [ 10% -> 5% ]

[i]- Sarasbati[/i]
Decreased conversion from HP to AD [ 10% -> 5% ]

[i]- Amaterasu[/i]
Increased conversion from MP to AP [ 10% -> 15% ]

[i]- Death Head[/i]
Decreased Critical chance [ 5% -> 3% ]


[h1]Systems[/h1]

[b]1. Armor / Magic Resitance Penetration[/b]
We adjusted the formular for these two values. With this the effect of both got increased and should now be more effiecient.

[b]2. Jewels[/b]
Yellow jewels can from now on only be traded after 24 hours of receiving.

[b]3. Taxes[/b]
We increased the amount of gold which gets paid every hour and reduced national resources. 

[b]4. Jungle Mobs[/b]
We slightly inreased the movement speed of the Giant Bears.

[b]5. Medals[/b]
Players one the Defense will receive 100% more medals in a PvP land battle.

[b]6. UI[/b]
We added an additional message for notifying players when the Civil War starts.

[b]7. Costumes[/b]
We added a new Costume to the game.
[i]-Ninja[/i]
[list]
[*] Dodge +5%
[*] Movement +5%
[/list]

[b] 8. Event Dungeon[/b]
We adjusted the places for Scattered Troops and Avenue of Spirit dungeons. The duration which while these are accessiable got increased. Players from both fractions can now enter. We also removed the waiting time after acquiring a land.

[b]9. Quests[/b]
We added some Lv. 30 Exclusive missions which feature different tasks and ranks. Thay can be bought at Freja. Only one rank mission can be active at a time. 

[h1] Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to the range of Bows and Daggers for Punisher
[*] Fixed an issue where mulitple speed debuffs got dublicated applied 
[*] Fixed a bug which limited the region

notes.title: Welcome
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/eadf1c6eb8778117f491eac71423538f43c4b344.jpg[/img]Welcome to our page for Warmonger.

We will use Early Access to balance the game and the monetization as well. So feedback regarding that will be highly appreciated.

We do not want to charge you for the EA version as we believe that would not be fair as it will be a F2P game in the end.

If we do a wipe during EA (not planned) all your cash investments with jewels will be refunded with an on top bonus of +10%. So if you charged 100 jewels you will have 110 after a wipe.

We will likely do a wipe at the end of EA with a 10% bonus as well.

Early Access is not planned forever and will likely last for a couple of months. We will talk about more features soon :) EA will only be the start!

See you ingame soon!
